parts.title: Word List
parts.content:
Detailed Meanings

😎
abstract[æbstrækt]adj.
If ideas are abstract, they are based on general ways of thinking.
→ The idea of beauty is abstract and changes over time.
😎
annual[ænjuəl]adj.
If something is annual, it happens once a year.
→ The only time I see my aunts and uncles is at our annual family picnic.
😎
clay[klei]n.
Clay is a type of heavy, wet soil used to make pots.
→ She made a bowl out of the clay.
😎
cloth[klɔ(:)θ]n.
Cloth is material used to make clothes.
→ His shirt is made of a very soft type of cloth.
😎
curtain[kə:rtən]n.
A curtain is a cloth hung over a window or used to divide a room.
→ She opened the curtains to let light into the room.
😎
deserve[dizə:rv]v.
To deserve is to be worthy of something as a result of one’s actions.
→ The dog deserved a bone for behaving very well.
😎
feather[feðər]n.
Feathers are the things covering birds’ bodies.
→ That bird has orange feathers on its chest.
😎
fertile[fə:rtl]adj.
If land is fertile, it is able to produce good crops and plants.
→ The farmer grew many vegetables in the fertile soil.
😎
flood[flʌd]n.
A flood is an event in which water covers an area which is usually dry.
→ After three days of rain, there was a flood in the city.
😎
furniture[fə:rnitʃər]n.
Furniture is the things used in a house such as tables and chairs.
→ His living room only had a few simple pieces of furniture.
😎
grave[greiv]n.
A grave is the place where a dead person is buried.
→ We visit our grandfather’s grave each year.
😎
ideal[aidi:əl]adj.
If something is ideal, it is the best that it can possibly be.
→ This house is an ideal place for my family. It has everything we need.
😎
intelligence[intelədʒəns]n.
Intelligence is the ability to learn and understand things.
→ Because of his high intelligence, he finished school early.
😎
nowadays[nauədeiz]adv.
If something happens nowadays, it happens at the present time.
→ In the past people walked everywhere. Nowadays, they use cars.
😎
obtain[əbtein]v.
To obtain is to get something you want or need.
→ After I passed the test, I obtained my driver’s license.
😎
religious[rilidʒəs]adj.
When something is religious, it has to do with religion.
→ The holy man spoke about religious topics.
😎
romantic[roumæntik]adj.
When something is romantic, it has to do with love.
→ The young couple went to see a romantic movie.
😎
shell[ʃel]n.
A shell is a hard covering that protects the body of some sea creatures.
→ There were many pretty shells on the beach.
😎
shore[ʃɔ:r]n.
A shore is the edge of a large body of water.
→ All of the boats were floating near the shore.
😎
wheel[hwi:l]n.
A wheel is a round thing on a vehicle that turns when it moves.
→ A car has four wheels.

sections.title: Exercise 1: Part A: Write a word that is similar in meaning to the underlined part.

questions.content: I need your help to move the tables and chairs. [ 1 ]
questions.explanation: furniture (n): đồ nội thất (bàn, ghế, v.v.).

questions.content: This problem will test your ability to understand. [ 2 ]
questions.explanation: intelligence (n): sự thông minh (khả năng học hỏi và hiểu biết).

questions.content: I don’t like to be in dark rooms with covers over the windows. [ 3 ]
questions.explanation: curtains (n): rèm cửa (vải treo trên cửa sổ).

questions.content: Tom and Rob are the best roommates. [ 4 ]
questions.explanation: ideal (adj): lý tưởng (tốt nhất có thể).

questions.content: I need to get a ticket before I can board the train. [ 5 ]
questions.explanation: obtain (v): đạt được, thu được (có được thứ bạn muốn hoặc cần).

sections.title: Exercise 1: Part B: Fill in the blanks with the correct words from the word bank.
sections.content: WORD BANK: clay, cloth, fertile, graves, flood. Jimmy went on a trip to Egypt. There, he visited the great pyramids. Inside them were the 1._________ of old kings. He also visited a village near the river and learned about a recent 2._________. People grew many crops on this 3._________ land. They used 4._________ pots to carry water from the river into their homes. One friendly man gave Jimmy a white 5._________ to cover his head from the hot sun. It was a wonderful trip.

questions.content: Inside them were the [ 6 ] of old kings.
options: graves
cloth
flood
clay
fertile
questions.explanation: graves (n): ngôi mộ (nơi chôn cất người chết).

questions.content: He also visited a village near the river and learned about a recent [ 7 ].
options: graves
cloth
flood
clay
fertile
questions.explanation: flood (n): lũ lụt (sự kiện nước bao phủ một khu vực thường khô ráo).

questions.content: People grew many crops on this [ 8 ] land.
options: graves
cloth
flood
clay
fertile
questions.explanation: fertile (adj): màu mỡ (có khả năng sản sinh ra cây trồng và thực vật tốt).

questions.content: They used [ 9 ] pots to carry water from the river into their homes.
options: graves
cloth
flood
clay
fertile
questions.explanation: clay (n): đất sét (một loại đất nặng, ướt được dùng để làm chậu).

questions.content: One friendly man gave Jimmy a white [ 10 ] to cover his head from the hot sun.
options: graves
cloth
flood
clay
fertile
questions.explanation: cloth (n): vải (vật liệu dùng để may quần áo).

sections.title: Exercise 2: Check the sentence with the bolded word that makes better sense.

options: a. Many people wear a shell before going out into the rain.
b. In the past three years, the city has had two floods.
questions.explanation: flood (n): lũ lụt. Lũ lụt là hiện tượng nước bao phủ một khu vực vốn dĩ khô ráo.

options: a. Nowadays, many students like using the Internet to do research.
b. Many groups have annual meetings every month.
questions.explanation: nowadays (adv): ngày nay. Nowadays có nghĩa là ở thời điểm hiện tại.

options: a. Some dogs have interesting feathers.
b. You cannot ride a bicycle if it doesn’t have wheels.
questions.explanation: wheel (n): bánh xe. Bánh xe là một bộ phận hình tròn trên các phương tiện giao thông, có thể quay khi di chuyển.

options: a. Churches don’t let people read religious books.
b. Birds use their feathers to help them fly.
questions.explanation: feather (n): lông vũ. Lông vũ là những chiếc lông bao phủ cơ thể loài chim.

options: a. Many people enjoy watching romantic movies.
b. If you get good grades, you don’t deserve to graduate.
questions.explanation: romantic (adj): lãng mạn. Lãng mạn có nghĩa là những gì liên quan đến tình yêu.

options: a. A crab is an example of an animal that has a shell.
b. People never go fishing near the shore.
questions.explanation: shell (n): vỏ cứng. Vỏ cứng là lớp vỏ bảo vệ cơ thể của một số sinh vật biển.

options: a. People who do bad things deserve to be punished.
b. Mountains and hills are examples of floods.
questions.explanation: deserve (v): xứng đáng. Xứng đáng có nghĩa là đáng được nhận một điều gì đó như là kết quả của những hành động mình đã làm.

options: a. Horses are more common than cars nowadays.
b. People who are religious go to church.
questions.explanation: religious (adj): thuộc về tôn giáo. Religious có nghĩa là những gì liên quan đến tôn giáo.

options: a. If you are romantic, you probably don’t like movies about love.
b. There are beaches along the shore of some oceans and lakes.
questions.explanation: shore (n): bờ biển/bờ hồ. Shore là phần rìa của một vùng nước lớn.

options: a. You should see your doctor once a year for an annual checkup.
b. The wind makes the wheels of a car turn.
questions.explanation: annual (adj): hàng năm. Annual có nghĩa là sự việc xảy ra mỗi năm một lần.

parts.title: Comprehensive Reading
parts.content:
Osiris and the Nile

Long ago, Osiris was the king of Egypt, and Isis was the queen. They ruled the fertile land by the Nile River. They had great intelligence, and they shared their abstract ideas with everyone. Osiris taught the Egyptians how to make wheels and furniture. Isis taught them how to make things from clay and cloth. The people thought they deserved a gift. So they built Osiris and Isis a pyramid. Everyone loved Osiris except his brother, Set. Set wanted to be king.

Osiris made his annual trip around Egypt and led religious events. The villages gave him beautiful shells and colorful feathers as gifts.

When Osiris returned, Set brought a beautiful wooden box from behind a curtain.

"If someone fits inside this box, I will give it to him or her," Set said.

Osiris got in it. It was an ideal fit!

Suddenly, Set closed the box and threw it into the river. "Now I will be king!" Set said.

The box washed up on a foreign shore after a flood. Isis brought his body home and obtained a grave for him in Egypt. The Egyptian gods thought Isis had done something very romantic.

Because of her love, the gods made him the god of the underworld. Osiris returned every spring to help the farmers. Even nowadays, people say Osiris keeps their crops alive.

options: a. Why Osiris built a pyramid for Isis
b. How Set created a grave for Osiris
c. How Osiris died and returned to make Egypt fertile
d. Why the gods thought Isis’ actions were romantic
questions.explanation: Câu chuyện chủ yếu kể về việc Osiris bị người anh em là Set hãm hại và giết chết như thế nào, và cuối cùng trở lại để giúp cho đất đai Ai Cập trở nên màu mỡ (Osiris returned every spring to help the farmers). Do đó đáp án C là chính xác.

options: a. Osiris gave people feathers and shells.
b. Set obtained furniture from people.
c. Set hid a box behind a curtain.
d. Osiris made an annual trip to villages.
questions.explanation: Đoạn văn có đề cập: Osiris made his annual trip around Egypt and led religious events (Osiris đã thực hiện chuyến đi hàng năm quanh Ai Cập và dẫn dắt các sự kiện tôn giáo). Chuyến đi hàng năm (annual) này chính là sự việc lặp lại mỗi mùa xuân. Do đó đáp án D là chính xác.

questions.content: In the last paragraph, we can infer that______________ .
options: a. the shore is the ideal home for Osiris
b. Set had greater intelligence than the gods
c. the gods felt that Isis did a good deed
d. nowadays, the Egyptians don’t use Osiris’ abstract ideas
questions.explanation: Trong bài đọc viết: The Egyptian gods thought Isis had done something very romantic. Because of her love, the gods made him the god of the underworld (Các vị thần Ai Cập cho rằng Isis đã làm một điều vô cùng lãng mạn. Vì tình yêu của bà, các vị thần đã phong ông làm thần của thế giới ngầm). Điều này cho thấy các vị thần cảm thấy Isis đã làm một việc làm tốt đẹp. Do đó đáp án C là chính xác.

questions.content: According to the passage, all the following are true EXCEPT
options: a. the Egyptians made wheels
b. the Egyptians used clay pots
c. the Egyptians made cloth
d. the Egyptians built religious villages
questions.explanation: Đoạn văn đề cập đến việc người Ai Cập được dạy cách làm bánh xe (wheels), đồ nội thất (furniture), đồ vật từ đất sét (clay) và vải (cloth). Bài đọc không nhắc đến việc họ xây dựng các ngôi làng tôn giáo. Do đó đáp án D là chính xác.

questions.content: What did the Egyptians do for their king and queen?
options: a. They made religious cloth.
b. They obtained furniture.
c. They built them a pyramid.
d. They threw them in a flood.
questions.explanation: Đoạn văn có viết: The people thought they deserved a gift. So they built Osiris and Isis a pyramid (Người dân nghĩ rằng họ xứng đáng với một món quà. Vì vậy, họ đã xây dựng cho Osiris và Isis một kim tự tháp). Do đó đáp án C là chính xác.
